stage_name_zh: 阶段 1：词汇激活、熟词生义破冰与句子主干剖析（Day 1–25）
learning_objectives_zh: 通过 8 个核心词群（涵盖今日 27 个目标词条）掌握熟悉词汇的学术熟词生义（Polysemy）、一词多义边界、可数/及物性变化与自然搭配。
掌握句子成分精细分析（主、谓、宾、表、定、状、同位语）与核心语法：【G018】状语从句、让步/条件结构与介词短语的紧凑转换；【G031】句子成分精细剖析（主、谓、宾、表、定、状、补、同位语）与核心主干定位。
掌握学术表达模式：【EP006】描述实验执行、基线核查与可复现流程，彻底消除头重脚轻、口语化、过度表达与空洞 AI 套话。
完成 36 道高密度、单点聚焦的实战练习，确保今日每个词条均获得至少 3 次训练（含至少 2 次主动输出）。

grammar_instruction.name: 状语从句、让步/条件结构与介词短语的紧凑转换
grammar_instruction.explanation_zh: 掌握从属连词（although, whereas, while, provided that, because, in that）、介词短语（despite, in spite of, due to, prior to, in light of, in the absence of）与连接副词（nevertheless, nonetheless, consequently, conversely）之间的句法转换。
rules: 让步压缩：Although the approach has limitations -> Albeit with limitations / Despite its limitations（严禁写 *despite of）。
条件限定：provided that / as long as + 完整分句 <-> subject to / under + 名词短语。
对照结构：whereas / while 连接两个对称分句（The first model uses monthly data, whereas the second uses daily data）。
examples: The approach is informative, albeit with limitations.
The result applies provided that the assumptions hold.
The estimate remains uncertain despite the larger sample.
common_errors: 混淆介词与连词：*despite the sample is large。
while 表对比时与时间含义发生歧义（在时序/并发场景中表对比优先用 whereas）。

grammar_instruction.name: 句子成分精细剖析（主、谓、宾、表、定、状、补、同位语）与核心主干定位
grammar_instruction.explanation_zh: 自然地道的英语写作建立在清晰的句子成分（Constituents）分工之上：主语（Subject，建议用简短核心名词短语）+ 谓语动词（Predicate Verb，承载核心动作或状态关系）+ 宾语/表语/补语（Object/Complement），而将限定范围、实验条件、时间窗口等次要信息合理分配给后置定语（Post-modifier）或状语（Adverbial）。
rules: 主语（S）与谓语（V）的距离应尽可能紧凑：避免在主语核心词和谓语动词之间插入过长的非必要修饰成分，防止读者丢失句子主干。
区分定语（修饰名词，回答 which/what kind of）与状语（修饰动词或全句，回答 how/when/where/under what condition）：英語长定语一律后置（介词短语、分词短语、定语从句），切忌按中文习惯把长串修饰语全部堆在名词前面。
同位语（Appositive，如 a random walk, an archetypal example of a nonstationary process）用于紧随名词后补充等价定义或量纲说明，比单独另起一句更紧凑。
examples: [主语 The affine function f(x) = ax + b] [谓语 includes] [宾语 an intercept b].
[状语 When the relevant variances are finite and nonzero], [主语 lag-one Pearson autocorrelation] [谓语 measures] [宾语 the linear association] [后置定语 between observations one time step apart].
[主语 The team] [谓语 abandoned] [宾语 the approach] [原因状语 after repeated calibration failures].
common_errors: 中式前置长定语堆砌：*The collected from three rural clinics during the two-year pilot study data were noisy（应改为 The data collected from three rural clinics during the two-year pilot study were noisy）。
把状语介词短语误当成主语：*In Table 1 shows the ablation results（应为 Table 1 shows... 或 In Table 1, we report...）。

grammar_instruction.name: 五大基本句型（SV, SVO, SVC, SVOO, SVOC）与动词配价边界
grammar_instruction.explanation_zh: 英语句子的核心骨架由谓语动词的及物性与配价决定：不及物动词构成 SV（Evidence accumulates / A problem arose），系动词构成 SVC（The label is meaningless），单及物动词构成 SVO（The team abandoned the approach），双及物动词构成 SVOO，复合宾语动词构成 SVOC（The pronoun makes the final sentence ambiguous）。严禁把不及物动词当及物动词用，或把及物动词误加介词。
rules: 不及物动词（arise, emerge, occur, differ, fluctuate, accumulate, oscillate）后不直接接名词宾语，需用状语或介词短语扩展。
单及物动词（address, discuss, access, affect, investigate, assess, warrant）直接接宾语，禁止按中文习惯误加介词（禁止写 *discuss about, *address to, *access to 作动词）。
SVOC 结构中宾语补足语用形容词或分词说明宾语状态（keep the room temperature constant, make the task easier）。
examples: SV: A problem arose when the data formats changed.
SVO: This paper addresses unequal access to educational resources.
SVC: Without a clear definition, the label is meaningless.
SVOC: The pronoun makes the final sentence ambiguous.
common_errors: 误将不及物动词用于被动或直接加宾语：*A problem was arisen / *differ two groups。
在及物动词后添加冗余介词：*discuss about the findings / *address to the limitation。
SVOC 中误用副词作宾补：*keep the room temperature constantly（应为 constant）。

expression_pattern_instruction.name: 描述实验执行、基线核查与可复现流程
expression_pattern_instruction.template: We conducted [experiment/survey] under controlled conditions and verified [readings/outputs] against [ground-truth/reference].
expression_pattern_instruction.explanation_zh: 直接、清晰地交代实验操作与质量核验步骤，避免头重脚轻。
examples: The team verified sensor readings against manual measurements.
Two analysts analysed the data independently.

expression_pattern_instruction.name: 精确区分可数样本量与不可数开销/证据
expression_pattern_instruction.template: While a large number of [plural countable nouns] were collected, the procedure required only a small amount of [uncountable noun].
expression_pattern_instruction.explanation_zh: 在数据集与实验开销描述中准确搭配可数与不可数量词。
examples: A large number of records still require checking.
The protocol requires a small amount of additional information.
common_errors: *a great deal of participants / *an amount of records。

scheduled_review_words.polysemy_trap_zh: 词义与句法边界：civil在本文与社会生活有关；日常可指有礼貌，civic含义相关但不随意互换。
